title: Hal Puthoff's medieval levitating secret society

tellings.quote: me off and he goes or it could be a medieval secret society that knows how to levitate and they put these metal capsules around them

plain: The objects people call UFOs could be, in one idea floated by the physicist Hal Puthoff, the work of a medieval secret society that knows how to levitate and wraps itself in metal capsules. Michels says Puthoff put it to him as one possibility: "it could be a medieval secret society that knows how to levitate and they put these metal capsules around them." If true, the source would be a hidden human group, not visitors from elsewhere.
